items.title: What Does Lam Research (LRCX) $15 Million STEM And AI Education Push Mean?
items.summary: Lam Research (NasdaqGS:LRCX) has committed US$15 million through the Lam Foundation to expand global STEM and AI literacy programs for youth. The funding includes a founding sponsorship of LEGO League, targeting children and teenagers with hands-on robotics and coding experiences. Lam plans to channel this commitment into multiple education partners worldwide to broaden access to computer science and AI learning tools.
